newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Rebound against the bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Rebound against the bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds put in a mild outperformance against the dollar bloc, reclaiming some of the lost ground seen after this week's budget.

Traders said the market was in slightly more confident mood as Wednesday's U.S. inflation data was seen lessening the chances of a Fed tightening and after reacting negatively to a budget statement that failed to live up to expectations.

The short-end was also getting fidgety over local monetary policy amid speculation of an easing, although Reserve Bank governor Ian Macfarlane again showed concern over wages growth in a speech in Melbourne today.
U.S. Treasuries face a raft of indicators later today with April CPI, industrial production and capacity untilisation, along with the weekly jobless claims data all due for release.
Canadian debt rallied with the U.S. on Wednesday following a sharp 0.6 percent drop in the April PPI.
New Zealand bonds were supported by a well received bond tender and after a rise in registered unemployment.
